hooks.command: j=$(cat); d=$(printf '\342\200\224'); printf '%s' "$j" | grep -qE '"file_path": *"[^"]*\.(md|mdx|txt|html?)"|>>? *[^ ]*\.(md|mdx|txt|html?)' && printf '%s' "$j" | grep -qF -e "$d" -e '\u2014' && { echo 'No em-dashes in prose. Rewrite those sentences with a colon, a comma, or two sentences.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
